_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Emma Larsson
about_me: I'm Emma, an HCI master's student at UMSI studying how wheelchair users navigate campus. I need 12 participants for interviews and a partner who builds mobility hardware.
goals: Recruit 12 wheelchair users for my navigation study

debriefs.text: Sofia Lindqvist, my labmate and a PhD student, is recruiting wheelchair users too, for an accessibility study. She suggested we share a recruitment flyer.
Met Kenji Watanabe from the Iyer robotics lab. He builds soft grippers for assistive arms and wants user feedback.
Hannah Brooks, the Ann Arbor city planner, said the city is redoing curb ramps on Main Street and wants accessibility input.
Talked to Hana Yoshida, a design student building accessible playground equipment. She knows parents who use wheelchairs.

request.need: Wheelchair users in Ann Arbor willing to do a paid one-hour interview
request.about_line: HCI master's student studying accessible campus navigation
